Worst pizza ever
Mar 2020
Just had two pizzas here and, without doubt, they were the worst ever. The pizza base was soggy and soft whilst the crust was properly cooked. How is it possible to make it that bad? I would love to know how they manage to get it so wrong. We tried to explain the problem to the very nice waitress and some guy who seemed to be the manager but got nowhere. We just decided to move on and warn other people to stay away. After reading the positive reviews about this place we strongly suggest you take them with a pinch of salt. Thumbs Up!
Sep 2019
Our Canadian friends were hungry after we spent half a day at Ben Thanh market. We found this Buzza Pizza just metres from our shopping haunt. Don't ask me why...we would've settled for Pho but white folks need their fix after 2 days out of kink....hahaha...just kidding.

Service was very good but please be aware that most staff we encountered, if not all, do not communicate in English. Perhaps it's our luck and the planets did not align for us but kudos to the them as they sincerely tried their darnest and kinda understood our 'Google' translated Vietnamese.

Our hunger messages got through and voila!...we thoroughly enjoyed the pizza!! Now if our Italian-Canadian friends say the pizzas were great...who are we to argue!

Highly recommended!

The Worst of the Worst
Dec 2019 • Family
This place, lamentably like a lot of eateries in Vietnam, doesn’t advertise that VAT and a service charge aren’t included in the noted prices on the menu and they charge for napkins. Seriously! For napkins!!! This place has two very separate and different t menus: a pizzeria and a bbq joint. We wanted pizza as well as a side order of spaghetti bolognese off the bbq menu for our 7 year old. The waitress told us we could only order a side off the bbq menu if we also ordered the most expensive item on the bbq menu: 850,000VND (in order to get the 30,000VND side we wanted). Insane! Again, like many eateries in Vietnam, westerners seem to find many items they want to order are Agfa belt unavailable on the menu and you are directed to another item, 3, 4, 5 or more times more expensive. This place is a waste of your time and a waste of your money. There are other pizza joints in HCMC. Try them instead.

What a horrible place! Cheating place, stay away at all costs.
Mar 2019 • Couples
We went there to redeem our Grab promotion as a take away. When we told them that it is take away the staff asked us to sit on very small chairs even though the whole restaurant was empty. Grab offered 49% discount for a European set which is one pizza (regular price 189k), one spaghetti vogle (RP 129k) and two coke (RP 60k) so the total price comes to 416k including 10% VAT. With 49% discount this should be 212k including tax, however, they informed us that the price is 212k + additional 13k for takeaway and then 10% VAT on top of that which makes it 248k. This is purely cheating. Besides, I felt so insulted while sitting near the door on a small chair as if I am a beggar who is waiting for the food. Shameful behavior of the owner of this restaurant. Is cheating only way for you to earn money? I strongly recommend to stay away from this cheating place. The only good thing is that the staff were very nice.

An undeservedly busy restaurant
Jan 2019 • Couples
I have no idea why this restaurant is anywhere near as busy as it was when we visited. The cocktails were weak and low on alcohol content. The garlic bread was dry and lukewarm. The breadcrumbed cheese was barely warm on arrival. The pizzas cannot be varied on toppings - we were told you can remove a topping but you can't replace it with an alternative - why on earth not?? The service is slow. There is absolutely no chance of ordering a starter and getting it before the main courses turn up, despite careful requests and agreement by the waitress on this - you just get your food when it's ready. There are very limited options for a vegetarian, especially as they won't let you exchange the meat for a veg on the pizza toppings. And don't ask them for a recommendation on a veggie pizza - you must look at the pictures carefully. When I asked which pizzas were vegetarian, explaining I don't eat meat, our waitress pointed to one covered in pepperoni; she didn't think that pepperoni is meat (and this wasn't a language problem, she was quite competent with English). Compared to other restaurants, it's expensive. It closes about 9.30pm. In summary, don't bother, you'll do a lot better to go somewhere else.
